schema.text: In the evening or after dark, how secure do you feel from crime or harassment on your usual trip?

options.text: I don't feel secure at all
I travel in the evening because I have to, but I don't feel secure
I avoid travelling in the evening because I don't feel secure
I don't travel in the evening or after dark

en.#In the evening or after dark, how secur: In the evening or after dark, how secure do you feel from crime or harassment on your usual trip?
en.#I don't feel secure at all: I don't feel secure at all
en.#I travel in the evening because I have: I travel in the evening because I have to, but I don't feel secure
en.#I avoid travelling in the evening becau: I avoid travelling in the evening because I don't feel secure
en.#I don't travel in the evening or after: I don't travel in the evening or after dark

it.#In the evening or after dark, how secur: Di sera o dopo il tramonto, quanto ti senti al sicuro da reati o molestie durante lo spostamento abituale?
it.#I don't feel secure at all: Non mi sento per niente al sicuro
it.#I travel in the evening because I have: Mi sposto di sera perché devo, ma non mi sento al sicuro
it.#I avoid travelling in the evening becau: Evito di spostarmi di sera perché non mi sento al sicuro
it.#I don't travel in the evening or after: Non mi sposto di sera o dopo il tramonto

fr.#In the evening or after dark, how secur: Le soir ou après la tombée de la nuit, dans quelle mesure vous sentez-vous à l’abri de la criminalité ou du harcèlement lors de votre trajet habituel ?
fr.#I don't feel secure at all: Je ne me sens pas du tout en sécurité
fr.#I feel slightly secure: Je me sens peu en sécurité
fr.#I feel moderately secure: Je me sens plutôt en sécurité
fr.#I feel very secure: Je me sens tout à fait en sécurité
fr.#I feel completely secure: Je me sens complètement en sécurité
fr.#I travel in the evening because I have: Je me déplace le soir parce que je dois le faire, mais je ne me sens pas en sécurité
fr.#I avoid travelling in the evening becau: J’évite de me déplacer le soir parce que je ne me sens pas en sécurité
fr.#I don't travel in the evening or after: Je ne me déplace pas le soir ni après la tombée de la nuit

de.#In the evening or after dark, how secur: Wie sicher fühlen Sie sich abends oder nach Einbruch der Dunkelheit auf Ihrem üblichen Weg vor Kriminalität oder Belästigung?
de.#I don't feel secure at all: Ich fühle mich überhaupt nicht sicher
de.#I travel in the evening because I have: Ich bin abends unterwegs, weil ich muss, fühle mich aber nicht sicher
de.#I avoid travelling in the evening becau: Ich vermeide es, abends unterwegs zu sein, weil ich mich nicht sicher fühle
de.#I don't travel in the evening or after: Ich bin abends oder nach Einbruch der Dunkelheit nicht unterwegs

tr.#In the evening or after dark, how secur: Akşamları veya hava karardıktan sonra, her zamanki yolculuğunuzda kendinizi suça veya tacize karşı ne kadar güvende hissediyorsunuz?
tr.#I travel in the evening because I have: Akşamları mecbur olduğum için yolculuk yapıyorum ama kendimi güvende hissetmiyorum
tr.#I avoid travelling in the evening becau: Kendimi güvende hissetmediğim için akşamları yolculuk yapmaktan kaçınıyorum
tr.#I don't travel in the evening or after: Akşamları veya hava karardıktan sonra yolculuk yapmıyorum

fa.#In the evening or after dark, how secur: شب‌ها یا پس از تاریک شدن هوا، در سفر معمول خود چقدر در برابر جرم یا آزار احساس امنیت می‌کنید؟
fa.#I feel moderately secure: تا حد متوسطی احساس امنیت می‌کنم
fa.#I travel in the evening because I have: شب‌ها رفت‌وآمد می‌کنم چون مجبورم، اما احساس امنیت نمی‌کنم
fa.#I avoid travelling in the evening becau: به دلیل احساس ناامنی، از رفت‌وآمد در شب پرهیز می‌کنم
fa.#I don't travel in the evening or after: شب‌ها یا پس از تاریک شدن هوا رفت‌وآمد نمی‌کنم

hu.#In the evening or after dark, how secur: Este vagy sötétedés után mennyire érzi magát biztonságban a bűncselekményekkel vagy a zaklatással szemben a szokásos útja során?
hu.#I travel in the evening because I have: Este azért közlekedem, mert muszáj, de nem érzem magam biztonságban
hu.#I avoid travelling in the evening becau: Kerülöm az esti közlekedést, mert nem érzem magam biztonságban
hu.#I don't travel in the evening or after: Este vagy sötétedés után nem közlekedem

ar.#In the evening or after dark, how secur: في المساء أو بعد حلول الظلام، ما مدى شعورك بالأمان من الجرائم أو التحرش في رحلتك المعتادة؟
ar.#I travel in the evening because I have: أتنقل في المساء لأنه لا خيار لي، لكنني لا أشعر بالأمان
ar.#I avoid travelling in the evening becau: أتجنب التنقل في المساء لأنني لا أشعر بالأمان
ar.#I don't travel in the evening or after: لا أتنقل في المساء أو بعد حلول الظلام
